Package com.miniandmore.app.service.criteria

Class BlogPostCriteria

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.criteria.BlogPostCriteria
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, tech.jhipster.service.Criteria
public class BlogPostCriteria extends Object implements Serializable, tech.jhipster.service.Criteria
Criteria class for the BlogPost entity. This class is used in
invalid reference 
com.miniandmore.app.web.rest.BlogPostResource
to receive all the possible filtering options from the Http GET request parameters. For example the following could be a valid request: /blog-posts?id.greaterThan=5&attr1.contains=something&attr2.specified=false As Spring is unable to properly convert the types, unless specific Filter class are used, we need to use fix type specific filters.
